fields.name: pageTitle
fields.label: Page title (browser tab and Google headline)
fields.hint: The headline Google shows for this page. Aim for about 50–60 characters; much longer titles are cut off with “…”. Say what the page is, then (optionally) the brand. The preview shows how it will look.

pattern.message: Too long: please keep this to 120 characters or fewer.

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.label: Meta description (search engines)
fields.hint: The grey text under the headline in Google results. Aim for about 120–160 characters (a sentence or two that makes someone want to click); longer is cut off. It does not change how well the page ranks, but it does change how many people click.

pattern.message: Too long: please keep this to 320 characters or fewer.

fields.name: ogDescription
fields.label: Social share description
fields.hint: The text under the headline on the share card. Aim for 100–200 characters. Leave empty to reuse the search description.

pattern.message: Too long: please keep this to 300 characters or fewer.

fields.name: contactEmail
fields.label: Contact email
fields.hint: The address people write to. It is used by every “Email us” link in the menu and footer, the closing-banner button, the fallback e-mail that opens when a form cannot be sent, and the contact address search engines read. It is also typed by hand (not linked to this box) in the Privacy page text, the updates feed file (feed.xml) and llms.txt — if you change it here, change it there too.

pattern.message: Enter one email address, like hello@example.com (no spaces).

fields.name: subpageTitle
fields.label: Browser-tab title on other pages (About, Privacy…)
fields.hint: The title shown in the browser tab and in social shares for every page except the homepage. Write {title} where the page's own title should go, e.g. {title} — COVERED.

fields.name: shareImage
fields.label: Social share picture
fields.hint: The picture that appears when the site is shared on WhatsApp, LinkedIn and similar apps, and the logo picture search engines use. Best size is 1200 × 630 pixels. Upload a picture or pick one from the library — web addresses are not accepted. Large photos are fine: the site makes small, fast copies automatically.

pattern.message: Pick or upload a picture (.jpg, .png, .webp, .gif, .avif or .svg). The file name may only use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.

fields.name: socialTitle
fields.label: Homepage: Social share headline
fields.hint: The bold headline on the card shown when the page is shared on WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Facebook and similar. Leave empty to reuse the search title. Aim for under 70 characters.

pattern.message: Too long: please keep this to 120 characters or fewer.

fields.name: shareImageAlt
fields.label: Homepage: Social share picture - description
fields.hint: Describe the share picture in a few words (for people who cannot see it). Leave empty if you have not chosen a picture of your own.

pattern.message: Too long: please keep this to 200 characters or fewer.

fields.name: canonicalUrl
fields.label: Homepage: Canonical address (advanced)
fields.hint: Only fill this in if this page is a copy of another page of this site and you want Google to treat the other one as the real one. Use an address like /about/ or https://coveredaccess.com/about/. Leave empty otherwise. A page with a different canonical address is left out of the sitemap.

pattern.message: Use an address on this site: /about/ or https://coveredaccess.com/about/.

fields.name: hideFromSearch
fields.label: Homepage: Hide this page from search engines
fields.hint: Switch on to ask Google and other search engines not to list this page, and to leave it out of the sitemap. People with the link can still open it. Use for pages that are not ready or not meant for search.

fields.name: lastModified
fields.label: Homepage: Sitemap - last changed
fields.hint: The date shown to search engines as “last changed”, written like 2026-08-14. Leave empty to use the date the page file last changed.

pattern.message: Write the date like 2026-08-14 (year-month-day), or leave empty.

fields.name: sitemapPriority
fields.label: Homepage: Sitemap - importance
fields.hint: How important this page is compared with your other pages (search engines treat it only as a hint). Leave unset unless you know you need it.

fields.name: sitemapChangefreq
fields.label: Homepage: Sitemap - how often it changes
fields.hint: How often this page usually changes (a hint to search engines). Leave unset unless you know you need it.

fields.name: feedTitle
fields.label: Updates feed name
fields.hint: The name given to the updates-feed link in every page's hidden header, which news-reader apps may show when they discover the feed from the page. Not visible on the pages themselves. The feed file (feed.xml) has its own title, which this box does not change.

fields.name: schemaSlogan
fields.label: Search-engine tagline
fields.hint: A one-line slogan for COVERED that search engines and AI assistants read. Not visible on the pages themselves.

fields.name: schemaDescription
fields.label: Search-engine description of COVERED
fields.hint: A short factual description of what COVERED is, read by search engines and AI assistants. Not visible on the pages themselves.

fields.name: schemaPlace
fields.label: Search-engine location
fields.hint: Where COVERED was founded, e.g. Exeter, United Kingdom. Read by search engines and AI assistants; not visible on the pages themselves.

fields.name: skipLink
fields.label: Skip link text
fields.hint: A hidden link that appears when someone presses Tab on any page. It lets keyboard and screen-reader users jump straight past the menu to the content.

fields.name: homeLabel
fields.label: Logo link — screen-reader label
fields.hint: Read aloud by screen readers for the COVERED logo in the top bar and footer. Not visible on the page.

fields.name: menuLabel
fields.label: Mobile menu button — screen-reader label
fields.hint: Read aloud for the three-line menu button on phones. Not visible on the page.

fields.name: backLabel
fields.label: “Back” button text (About, Privacy and other pages)
fields.hint: The button at the right of the top bar on every page except the homepage. It links back to the homepage.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Menu links
fields.hint: The links in the top bar of the homepage, left to right (on phones they appear in the menu that opens from the three-line button). Drag to reorder, add or delete links. Keep it to 8 or fewer so the bar fits. A link to a homepage section disappears by itself while that section is hidden in “Page layout”.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link text
fields.hint: The words shown in the top bar.

fields.name: button
fields.label: Show as a highlighted button
fields.hint: Turns the link into the highlighted button (the accent-coloured one), like “Advertise with us”.

types.name: link
types.label: 🔗 Link to a page or website

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link text
fields.hint: The words shown in the top bar.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Address
fields.hint: Where the link goes. Type / for a page on this site (e.g. /about/), /#faq for a section of the homepage, #faq for a spot on the same page, https:// (or http://) for another website, or mailto: for an email link. The box refuses anything else, because an address such as www.example.com or about would quietly turn into a link to the homepage.

pattern.message: Start with / for a page on this site (e.g. /about/), /#faq for a section of the homepage, # for a spot on the same page, https:// for another website, or mailto: for an email link. An address like www.example.com must start with https://.

fields.name: button
fields.label: Show as a highlighted button
fields.hint: Turns the link into the highlighted button (the accent-coloured one).

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link text
fields.hint: Opens an email to the contact address set in “Site-wide”.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Tagline under the logo
fields.hint: The short sentence under the COVERED logo in the footer of the homepage.

fields.name: columns
fields.label: Link columns
fields.hint: The columns of links in the footer of the homepage (currently “Explore” and “Partner”). Drag to reorder, add or delete columns.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Column heading
fields.hint: The small capitals heading above the links.

fields.name: ariaLabel
fields.label: Screen-reader label
fields.hint: Read aloud by screen readers to describe this group of links, e.g. “Footer — explore”. Not visible. If left empty the column heading is used.

fields.name: links
fields.label: Links
fields.hint: A link to a homepage section disappears by itself while that section is hidden in “Page layout”.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link text
fields.hint: Opens an email to the contact address set in “Site-wide”.

fields.name: copyright
fields.label: Copyright line
fields.hint: Bottom-left of the footer. Write {year} where the current year should appear — it updates itself every January. (Pages other than the homepage show the line without the year.)

fields.name: updatedLabel
fields.label: “Last updated” label
fields.hint: The words before the date in the footer, e.g. “Last updated:”.

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.label: Last updated date
fields.hint: Shown after the label in the footer of the homepage. Leave empty to hide the whole “Last updated” line.

fields.name: signOff
fields.label: Sign-off message
fields.hint: The handwritten-style message at the bottom of the homepage footer.

fields.name: signOffEmoji
fields.label: Sign-off emoji
fields.hint: A single emoji shown after the sign-off message. Decorative only.

fields.name: compactLinks
fields.label: Short footer links (About, Privacy and other pages)
fields.hint: Every page except the homepage has a slim footer: the copyright line plus these links, separated by dots.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link text
fields.hint: Opens an email to the contact address set in “Site-wide”.

homepage.label: 🧩 Page layout — order, add & hide sections

fields.name: sections
fields.label: Homepage sections
fields.hint: This is the running order of the homepage, top to bottom. Drag sections to reorder the page, untick “Show this section” to hide one without deleting it, and use the add button to drop in your own text, image, number, banner or Q&A blocks. Each built-in section (hero, ticker, FAQ…) should appear only once — if one is added twice, only the first copy is shown on the site. Your own blocks can repeat freely.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Show this section
fields.hint: The hero holds the page's main heading. If you hide it, an invisible fallback heading (the site title) is used so search engines and screen readers still find one — but the page will open more abruptly.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Ticker words
fields.hint: The words that scroll across the moving strip under the hero (Universities, Train stations, Stadiums…), in this order. If you empty the list the strip disappears — to hide it deliberately, untick “Show this section” instead.

fields.name: pauseLabel
fields.label: Pause button — screen-reader label
fields.hint: Not visible on the page. Read aloud by screen readers for the small pause (⏸) button at the left end of the ticker.

fields.name: screenReaderIntro
fields.label: Hidden sentence — start
fields.hint: Not visible on the page. The ticker is hidden from screen readers, so they read one sentence instead: this start, then your ticker words in lowercase, then the ending. Example: “Target venues include universities, train stations and schools.”

fields.name: screenReaderJoiner
fields.label: Hidden sentence — word before the last item
fields.hint: Usually “and”. Placed between the second-to-last and last ticker word in the hidden sentence.

fields.name: screenReaderEnd
fields.label: Hidden sentence — ending
fields.hint: Usually a full stop. Added after the last ticker word in the hidden sentence.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Show this section
fields.hint: The banner’s heading, text and button label are edited under “Site-wide (title, contact, CTA)”; the fields below are the small extras.

fields.name: ariaLabel
fields.label: Section name — screen-reader label
fields.hint: Not visible on the page. Read aloud by screen readers when they reach the closing section (brand animation + banner).

fields.name: videoLabel
fields.label: Brand animation — description (accessibility)
fields.hint: Not visible on the page. Describes the “covered.” animation above the banner for screen-reader users and anyone who can’t see the video.

fields.name: emailSubject
fields.label: Email subject line
fields.hint: The subject that is pre-filled when someone clicks the banner button and their email app opens. The address itself is the contact email under “Site-wide”. Leave empty for no pre-filled subject.

fields.name: video
fields.label: Brand animation — video
fields.hint: The short “covered.” animation that plays above the closing banner when it scrolls into view. Leave both boxes empty to hide the animation.

fields.name: src
fields.label: Video file
fields.hint: Upload or pick an .mp4 video — web addresses are not accepted. Leave empty to hide the animation.

pattern.message: Pick or upload an .mp4 (or .webm / .m4v) video. The file name may only use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Cover picture (shown before it plays)
fields.hint: The still picture shown until the video starts; its shape also sets the shape of the video on the page. Upload a picture or pick one from the library — web addresses are not accepted. Large photos are fine: the site makes small, fast copies automatically.

pattern.message: Pick or upload a picture (.jpg, .png, .webp, .gif, .avif or .svg). The file name may only use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.

fields.name: anchor
fields.label: Link anchor
fields.hint: Gives this block its own link — the anchor “our-story” lets /#our-story scroll straight to it.

pattern.message: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only, and not a name the site already uses (like faq or brands) — e.g. our-story

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.hint: The picture shown beside the text. Upload a picture or pick one from the library — web addresses are not accepted. Large photos are fine: the site makes small, fast copies automatically.

pattern.message: Pick or upload a picture (.jpg, .png, .webp, .gif, .avif or .svg). The file name may only use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Image description (accessibility)
fields.hint: Describe what the picture shows in one short sentence, for people who cannot see it (screen readers read it aloud). Say what is in it, not "picture of". Required, unless you tick "Decorative picture" below.

fields.name: decorative
fields.label: Decorative picture (no description needed)
fields.hint: Tick this only if the picture adds no information (pure decoration), so screen readers skip it and no description is needed. Leave it unticked for any photo that shows something, and fill in the description above instead.

fields.name: anchor
fields.label: Link anchor
fields.hint: Gives this block its own link — the anchor “our-story” lets /#our-story scroll straight to it.

pattern.message: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only, and not a name the site already uses (like faq or brands) — e.g. our-story

fields.name: anchor
fields.label: Link anchor
fields.hint: Gives this block its own link — the anchor “our-numbers” lets /#our-numbers scroll straight to it.

pattern.message: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only, and not a name the site already uses (like faq or brands) — e.g. our-numbers

fields.name: buttonLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.hint: Where the button goes. Type / for a page on this site (e.g. /about/), /#faq for a section of the homepage, #faq for a spot on the same page, https:// (or http://) for another website, or mailto: for an email link. The box refuses anything else, because an address such as www.example.com or about would quietly turn into a link to the homepage. The button only appears when it has text; if you leave this empty it links to the homepage.

pattern.message: Start with / for a page on this site (e.g. /about/), /#faq for a section of the homepage, # for a spot on the same page, https:// for another website, or mailto: for an email link. An address like www.example.com must start with https://.

fields.name: anchor
fields.label: Link anchor
fields.hint: Gives this block its own link — the anchor “join-us” lets /#join-us scroll straight to it.

pattern.message: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only, and not a name the site already uses (like faq or brands) — e.g. join-us

fields.name: anchor
fields.label: Link anchor
fields.hint: Gives this block its own link — the anchor “more-questions” lets /#more-questions scroll straight to it.

pattern.message: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only, and not a name the site already uses (like faq or brands) — e.g. more-questions

fields.name: paper
fields.label: Page background
fields.hint: The main background of the whole site. It is also the colour of text on dark areas (the footer, dark sections and outlined buttons). Note — the COVERED logo colours are part of the logo artwork and cannot be changed here. When changing any colour, keep text/background contrast at least 4.5:1 (webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker). The preview beside this form re-checks every pairing of these colours as you type and lists any that are too low, with the ratio. Clearing a colour restores its default.

fields.name: paper2
fields.label: Small panels & tags
fields.hint: A slightly deeper tint for small panels and tags (the mobile menu, the demo phone screen, step numbers and the “roadmap” tag), and the colour of text on the dark sections. Also colours the browser bar on mobile — and the keyboard focus ring on the dark sections, the footer and the closing banner, so keep it light (at least 3:1 contrast against the main text colour).

fields.name: bandGrass
fields.label: Backgrounds — partner wall band
fields.hint: The background band behind the partner wall.

fields.name: bandLav
fields.label: Backgrounds — opening screen band
fields.hint: The background of the opening screen. You see it behind the scrolling dispenser animation while its pictures load (or if they cannot play).

fields.name: bandRosa
fields.label: Backgrounds — how-it-works band
fields.hint: The background band behind the interactive demo section.

fields.name: peach
fields.label: Hover tint on dark areas
fields.hint: The light tint used when hovering over footer links and the closing-banner button, and for the “pilot” badge on a selected city button.

fields.name: ink
fields.label: Main text & dark sections
fields.hint: The main text colour. It also fills the dark sections, the closing banner and the phone and machine outlines in the demo, and tints hairlines and card shadows. Keep it dark: it must read clearly on the page background (at least 4.5:1 contrast).

fields.name: inkDeep
fields.label: Footer & deepest dark
fields.hint: The footer background and the darkest accents (the small labels and full stops on the model and roadmap sections). Also the keyboard focus ring on the ticker, model and roadmap sections, so keep it dark (at least 3:1 contrast against those sections).

fields.name: inkSoft
fields.label: Secondary text
fields.hint: A softer dark colour for subheadings, descriptions and the paragraphs inside cards.

fields.name: muted
fields.label: Quiet text (captions & small print)
fields.hint: Quieter text such as captions, the statistics source line and small print — keep at least 4.5:1 contrast on the page background.

fields.name: accent
fields.label: Accent colour (highlights & fills)
fields.hint: The brand's primary accent: the reading-progress bar, the active step in the demo, the roadmap section background, the closing-banner button, the full stops after headings on dark sections, and confetti.

fields.name: accentDeep
fields.label: Button colour (white text on top)
fields.hint: The fill of the main buttons, which carry white text — keep it dark enough for that text to stay readable. Also used for strong accents: menu hover, the big statistic numbers, step numbers, the live city's pin and highlighted manifesto words.

fields.name: accentDark
fields.label: Accent text on light backgrounds
fields.hint: The strongest accent: the small uppercase labels above section headings, button hover, the “paid” line on the receipt and keyboard focus outlines on light backgrounds (needs strong contrast).

fields.name: kickerBand
fields.label: Small kicker labels (not used yet)
fields.hint: Meant for the small uppercase labels above section headings. At the moment those labels follow “Accent text on light backgrounds” instead, so changing this box has no visible effect yet.

fields.name: grass
fields.label: Status dots & lights
fields.hint: The pulsing dot in the opening-screen badge, the status light on the demo machine, footer link hover and one of the confetti colours. Keep it light enough to show on the dark sections.

fields.name: grassDark
fields.label: Ticks & completed steps
fields.hint: Text and icons in this colour on light backgrounds: the tick marks in the venue lists, finished steps in the demo's progress bar and the third roadmap tag.

fields.name: lavender
fields.label: Soft fills (ticker, model section, pills)
fields.hint: The soft highlight colour: the ticker strip, the model section background, the map's land shape, pill and chip backgrounds, the highlighter underline in the opening headline and one of the confetti colours. Keyboard focus rings on the ticker and model section use the “Footer & deepest dark” colour, so keep this light enough for them to stay visible.

fields.name: fonts
fields.label: Fonts
fields.hint: Choose which of the site’s own fonts is used where. Every value is kept within safe limits, so nothing typed here can break the layout. Clearing a value restores the shipped one.

fields.name: display
fields.label: Big headline font
fields.hint: The typeface of the biggest words: the opening headline, the section titles, the stamp-style quote and the receipt. Only fonts that are already part of the site can be chosen.

options.label: Open Sauce One (the clean paragraph typeface)

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading & label font
fields.hint: The typeface of smaller headings, buttons, small labels, card titles and the figures in the statistics.

options.label: Open Sauce One (the clean paragraph typeface)

fields.name: body
fields.label: Paragraph font
fields.hint: The typeface of ordinary paragraphs, form fields and descriptions.

options.label: Open Sauce One (the clean paragraph typeface)

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text sizes
fields.hint: How big each kind of text is. Every value is kept within safe limits, so nothing typed here can break the layout. Clearing a value restores the shipped one.

fields.name: baseSize
fields.label: Overall text size
fields.hint: Scales ALL text and most spacing on the site at once (100 = normal, 110 = 10% bigger). Visitors who set a larger text size in their browser still get larger text. Allowed range 80 to 130 (%).

fields.name: small
fields.label: Small text size
fields.hint: The size of small descriptions, card captions and statistic labels, in rem (1 rem = normal body text). Shipped value 0.93. Allowed range 0.7 to 1.2 (rem).

fields.name: lead
fields.label: Section intro text
fields.hint: The paragraph that sits under each section title. Sizes are in rem (1 rem = normal body text); it grows with the width of the screen between the smallest and the largest size.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Section intro text — smallest size
fields.hint: On phones the text is never smaller than this. In rem, from 0.8 to 2. Shipped value 1.05.

fields.name: fluid
fields.label: Section intro text — grows with screen width
fields.hint: How fast the text grows as the screen gets wider (in % of the screen width). In % of screen width, from 0 to 6. Shipped value 2.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Section intro text — largest size
fields.hint: On big screens the text is never bigger than this. In rem, from 0.9 to 3. Shipped value 1.2.

fields.name: heroLead
fields.label: Opening-screen intro text
fields.hint: The short paragraph under the opening headline (when the animated opening is not showing). Sizes in rem; grows with screen width between the smallest and the largest size.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Opening-screen intro text — smallest size
fields.hint: On phones the text is never smaller than this. In rem, from 0.8 to 2. Shipped value 1.05.

fields.name: fluid
fields.label: Opening-screen intro text — grows with screen width
fields.hint: How fast the text grows as the screen gets wider (in % of the screen width). In % of screen width, from 0 to 6. Shipped value 2.2.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Opening-screen intro text — largest size
fields.hint: On big screens the text is never bigger than this. In rem, from 0.9 to 3. Shipped value 1.25.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Closing-banner heading
fields.hint: The heading inside the closing call-to-action banner. Sizes in rem; grows with screen width between the smallest and the largest size.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Closing-banner heading — smallest size
fields.hint: On phones the text is never smaller than this. In rem, from 1 to 4. Shipped value 1.8.

fields.name: fluid
fields.label: Closing-banner heading — grows with screen width
fields.hint: How fast the text grows as the screen gets wider (in % of the screen width). In % of screen width, from 0 to 10. Shipped value 4.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Closing-banner heading — largest size
fields.hint: On big screens the text is never bigger than this. In rem, from 1.2 to 6. Shipped value 2.6.

fields.name: stat
fields.label: Statistic figures
fields.hint: The big numbers in the problem section. Sizes in rem; grows with screen width between the smallest and the largest size.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Statistic figures — smallest size
fields.hint: On phones the text is never smaller than this. In rem, from 1.2 to 5. Shipped value 2.6.

fields.name: fluid
fields.label: Statistic figures — grows with screen width
fields.hint: How fast the text grows as the screen gets wider (in % of the screen width). In % of screen width, from 0 to 10. Shipped value 5.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Statistic figures — largest size
fields.hint: On big screens the text is never bigger than this. In rem, from 1.5 to 7. Shipped value 3.4.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Manifesto quote
fields.hint: The large uppercase quote whose words light up as you scroll. Sizes in rem; grows with screen width between the smallest and the largest size.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Manifesto quote — smallest size
fields.hint: On phones the text is never smaller than this. In rem, from 1 to 4. Shipped value 1.5.

fields.name: fluid
fields.label: Manifesto quote — grows with screen width
fields.hint: How fast the text grows as the screen gets wider (in % of the screen width). In % of screen width, from 0 to 8. Shipped value 2.9.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Manifesto quote — largest size
fields.hint: On big screens the text is never bigger than this. In rem, from 1.2 to 5. Shipped value 2.5.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Section titles
fields.hint: The big title at the top of every section. Sizes in rem; grows with screen width between the smallest and the largest size.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Section titles — smallest size
fields.hint: On phones the text is never smaller than this. In rem, from 1.9 to 6 (smaller would make section titles too small to read on their coloured backgrounds). Shipped value 2.5.

fields.name: fluid
fields.label: Section titles — grows with screen width
fields.hint: How fast the text grows as the screen gets wider (in % of the screen width). In % of screen width, from 0 to 12. Shipped value 5.5.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Section titles — largest size
fields.hint: On big screens the text is never bigger than this. In rem, from 1.9 to 9. Shipped value 4.2.

fields.name: heroPin
fields.label: Opening headline (animated opening)
fields.hint: The headline over the scrolling dispenser animation. It also has a height limit, so the headline, buttons and animation always fit the screen: whichever of “grows with width” and “height limit” is smaller wins.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Opening headline (animated opening) — smallest size
fields.hint: On phones the text is never smaller than this. In rem, from 1.5 to 5. Shipped value 2.6.

fields.name: fluid
fields.label: Opening headline (animated opening) — grows with screen width

fields.name: body

fields.name: kicker

fields.name: weights

fields.name: min

fields.name: fluid

fields.name: max

fields.name: containerWidth

fields.name: shape

fields.name: radiusButton

fields.name: radiusPill

fields.hint: Where the button goes. Type / for a page on this site (e.g. /about/), /#faq for a section of the homepage, #faq for a spot on the same page, https:// (or http://) for another website, or mailto: for an email link. The box refuses anything else, because an address such as www.example.com or about would quietly turn into a link to the homepage. The button only appears when it has text; if you leave this empty it links to the homepage.
